name: teleport-lab
title: Teleport Lab
description: Teleport APQBs with several θ and read θ back on the receiving qubit.

files./apps/teleport-lab/main.qsh:
echo == APQB teleportation ==
draw teleport 0.7
run teleport 0.2 --shots 1
run teleport 0.7 --shots 1
run teleport 1.2 --shots 1
echo q2 theta should equal the sent theta each time
